notes.title: Achievements, New Mode & Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
We're delighted to present you a new mode for Ratergy!

Cheese Hunt is a traditional Capture the Flag mode where you battle against each other on a brand new map. The update also includes another new map where you can enjoy the classic 2 vs 2 Ratergy playstyle. 

Additionally we just released a demo for [URL=https://store.steampowered.com/app/815480/Ratergy/]Ratergy[/URL] to get your feet wet before you decide to dive into the full game. You can find the button to download the Demo on the right column right beneath "Is this game relevant to you?"

The update also brings you a bunch of creative achievements, some trickier than others, which will require some great skill to achieve. 

Have fun!
